name: io.tryvital.vitalhealthconnect.SyncBroadcastReceiver
description: Junction Vital Health Connect runs this receiver after device boot, quick boot, exact-alarm permission changes, or its scheduled sync action. It checks that Health Connect and background sync are available, reschedules the next alarm, and starts a foreground sync when an alarm fires.
disableEffect: Scheduled background Health Connect updates will no longer be handled, so the app may miss automatic health-data syncs.
